subtitle: Space settings: people, roles, groups and invitations.

toast.error: The action could not be completed.

apiUnavailable.title: Roles are not available yet.
apiUnavailable.body: The server did not answer for this section. Basic roles are used meanwhile.

cascade.explain: How it is decided: the person's groups are checked first, then their personal roles, and finally the default role. The first layer that is not on “Inherit” wins.

administrator.name: Administrator
administrator.desc: Can do everything in the space unless it is denied higher up. Give it with great care.

team_manage.name: Manage the space
team_manage.desc: Change the space name and settings.

roles_manage.name: Manage roles
roles_manage.desc: Create, edit and order roles below their own.

groups_manage.name: Manage groups
groups_manage.desc: Create groups and change their members and roles.

audit_view.name: View the moderation log
audit_view.desc: See who kicked, banned or muted and when.

members_invite.name: Invite people
members_invite.desc: Send invitations and create links to join the space.

invites_manage.name: Manage invitations
invites_manage.desc: Revoke other people's invitations and links.

members_manage.name: Manage members
members_manage.desc: View and adjust space members (alias, status).

members_manage_roles.name: Assign roles
members_manage_roles.desc: Give or remove roles from members, only those below their own.

members_kick.name: Kick members
members_kick.desc: Remove someone from the space (they can return with an invitation).

members_ban.name: Ban members
members_ban.desc: Remove someone and block them from joining again.

boards_create.name: Create boards
boards_create.desc: Create new boards in the space.

documents_create.name: Create documents
documents_create.desc: Create new documents in the space.

content_manage_all.name: Manage all content
content_manage_all.desc: See and manage every board and document, including other people's private ones.

marketplace_import.name: Import from the marketplace
marketplace_import.desc: Install marketplace packs into the space.

rooms_manage.name: Manage rooms
rooms_manage.desc: Edit, archive and organise the space rooms.

room_view.name: View rooms
room_view.desc: See rooms and read their messages.

room_call.name: Make calls
room_call.desc: Start or join voice and video calls.

room_mention_everyone.name: Mention everyone
room_mention_everyone.desc: Use @everyone to notify the whole room.

room_manage.name: Manage a room
room_manage.desc: Change a room's name, topic and permissions.

scripts_manage.name: Manage scripts
scripts_manage.desc: Create, edit and publish scripts and automations.

env_manage.name: Manage secret variables
env_manage.desc: See and change environment variables and secrets used by scripts.

sql_query.name: Query with SQL
sql_query.desc: Run queries on the available connections.

billing_manage.name: Manage billing
billing_manage.desc: See and change the plan, payments and credits.

block.owner_role: The Owner role is fixed: nobody edits or assigns it.
block.position: This role is at or above your own level.
block.not_owned: You cannot grant a permission you do not have.
block.owner_only: Only the owner can change this permission.
block.noRolesManage: You do not have permission to manage roles.

member.self: You cannot do this to yourself.
member.target_owner: Nobody can act on the owner.
member.position: Their highest role is equal to or above yours.

list.title: Role hierarchy
list.hint: Top = highest. Drag or use the arrows to reorder.
list.readOnly: Only people who manage roles can reorder them.

editor.pick: Pick a role to edit it.
editor.systemNote: This is a system role: you can change its name, colour and permissions, but not delete it.
editor.ownerNote: The owner can do everything and this role is not edited. To change owner use “Transfer ownership” in Overview.

display.name: Name
display.nameInvalid: The name must be 1 to 40 characters and cannot contain < > [ ].
display.mentionableHelp: Anyone can notify people with this role using @.

delete.title: Delete role
delete.description: People who have this role will lose it. This cannot be undone.

sim.title: Permission simulator
sim.help: Pick a person and see what they can do and why. It is an approximation using this screen's data: the server has the final say.

rolesDialog.title: Roles for {{name}}
rolesDialog.help: You can only assign roles below your own.

help.kick: They leave the space but can return with an invitation.
help.ban: They leave the space and cannot join again by invitation until you lift the ban.
help.mute: They will not be able to write while muted.

moderation.reasonHelp: It is kept in the moderation log.

alias.title: Alias in the space
alias.help: The name they are shown with in this space.

leave.title: Leave the space
leave.body: You will lose access to this space. Sure?

invite.groupsNeedPermission: To add groups you need the permission to manage groups.
invite.summaryTitle: What the person gets on accepting
invite.summaryNote: It never lowers the role of someone who is already a member.
invite.neverWarning: A link that never expires stays valid even if you forget it: revoke it when it is no longer needed.
invite.deliverySkipped: The invitation was created but the email was not sent (no mail server).
invite.deliveryFailed: The invitation was created but sending the email failed.
invite.linkHelp: Anyone with the link joins with the roles and groups you choose.
invite.personal: A personal space does not support invitations.
invite.noPermission: Your role cannot invite people to this space.

groups.title: Groups
groups.hint: Named sets of people. They can have roles that all their members inherit.
groups.emptyBody: Create one to mention, share with and give roles to several people at once.
groups.emptyReadOnly: People who manage groups can create them.
groups.name: Name
groups.mentionHelp: It is generated from the name.
groups.deleteDescription: Its members lose what they got through the group.
groups.rolesHelp: Everyone in the group gets these roles. The group's permissions are checked first.
groups.resourcesHelp: Boards and documents shared with this group.
groups.resourcesNoneBody: Share a board or document with the group from its share menu.

audit.unbanBody: They will be able to join again with an invitation.

overview.name: Name
overview.noRename: Only people who manage the space can change the name.
overview.personal: A personal space cannot be renamed.
overview.myRole: Your role and what you can do
overview.noRoles: No personal roles: the default role applies.
overview.myPermissionsHelp: The server decides this from your roles and groups.
overview.fallback: Your permissions could not be fetched: the basics of your role are shown.
overview.ownerAll: You are the owner: you can do everything.
overview.nothing: You have no special permissions for now.
overview.dangerOwnerOnly: Only the owner can transfer or delete the space.
overview.transferHelp: The chosen person becomes the single owner and you become an admin.
overview.transferWarn: You will lose full control of the space. Only the new owner can give it back.
overview.deleteHelp: Its boards, documents and members are deleted. This cannot be undone.
overview.deleteWarn: This deletes all the space content and cannot be undone.

catalog.approxBody: The full permission catalogue could not be loaded from the server, so a basic list is shown. Integrations and extensions do not appear until it loads.
catalog.dangerousTitle: Sensitive permission: give it only to people you trust.
catalog.dangerConfirmBody: This is a sensitive permission: it allows far-reaching actions. Are you sure you want to allow it?
catalog.requires: Needs “{{names}}”, which is not allowed here.
catalog.obsoleteBody: They come from an integration or extension that is no longer installed. They stay in the role but grant nothing, and cannot be edited.
catalog.obsoleteLocked: Obsolete: its source is no longer installed.
catalog.obsoleteInOverrides: There are obsolete permissions stored here that are not shown and grant nothing: {{keys}}.

resource.intro: Adjust who can view, comment, edit or manage. “Inherit” lets the next layer decide: member, group, role and finally everyone.
resource.search: Search a role, group or person
resource.empty: No special settings: the normal access applies.
resource.readOnly: Only people who manage this item can change the permissions.
resource.unavailable: Detailed permissions are not available on this server yet.
